What VEIL is / is not

Screening. Not a jacket. Not a building.

VEIL isVEIL is not
Removable visual / weather screeningA fire enclosure
Light-value landscape patternsDark hunting camo
No weld / no drillA tank modification
Service-friendly (dome flap; PRV, fill, gauge, plate clear)An insulating cover (see US 7,731,052)
Retail + kit pathsA pressure vessel or setback change

Pilot design

Six tanks. Ninety days. Sleeve first.

Hero size

500-gal Sleeve.

90 days

Then a written go / no-go — not an open-ended build.

Measure

Install time, customer reaction, inspector notes, margin actuals, failure modes (wind, snow, Dual Lock wear).

Go / no-go

Propose go only if all five hold.

  1. Pilot units placed and feedback is net positive
  2. No safety / clearance incidents
  3. Sleeve margin holds after real sew cost
  4. Clear path to reorder fabric / Dual Lock without drama
  5. Board comfort with trade-style marketing under IP notice rules

Pause if safety issues, margin collapse, or inspector rejection of light-value wraps as used.

IP + prior art

Trade style at the co-op. Title stays with Micah.

“VEIL by EFE” is a marketing trade style. Patent rights stay with Micah Kleinert unless a separate written assignment says otherwise.

USPTO: U.S. provisional on file. Patent pending, App. No. 64/158,376, filed September 19, 2026. First named inventor Micah Woodrow Kleinert. Title: Removable camouflage cover system for aboveground liquefied-petroleum-gas storage tanks. Not an issued patent. Do not print “Patented.”

US 7,731,052 is a camouflaging and insulating cover. VEIL is specified as non-insulating visual / weather screening so it does not live in that claim space and so the tank can still exchange heat with outdoor air.

Vendors for quotes under the lean cap: Magnum Magnetics; Sunbrella / Glen Raven class; Avery / 3M via Grimco / Printwise; 3M Dual Lock; local Northern Michigan marine canvas shop. Tank Wear / Eastside Canvas / Fairway-Acme shops were briefed. No quote dollars are printed here because none were locked.
